protocol_lines.text: * Phase 2: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of unresectable or metastatic NSCLC with KRAS G12C mutation and any PD-L1 TPS
* Phase 3: Histologically confirmed diagnosis of unresectable or metastatic squamous or nonsquamous NSCLC with KRAS G12C mutation and PD-L1 TPS\>=50%
* Phase 3: Presence of measurable disease per RECIST1.1
* Phase 3: CNS Inclusion - Based on screening brain imaging, patients must have one of the following:
2. Untreated brain metastases not needing immediate local therapy
3. Previously treated brain metastases not needing immediate local therapy

* Phase 2 and Phase 3: Prior systemic treatment for locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC including chemotherapy, immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy, or a therapy targeting KRAS G12C mutation (e.g., AMG 510).
* Phase 3: Patients with known central nervous system (CNS) lesions must not have any of the following:
1. Any untreated brain lesions \> 2.0 cm in size
3. Ongoing use of systemic corticosteroids for control of symptoms of brain lesions at a total daily dose of \> 10 mg of prednisone (or equivalent) prior to randomization.
4. Have poorly controlled (\> 1/week) generalized or complex partial seizures, or manifest neurologic progression due to brain lesions notwithstanding CNS-directed therapy
* Phase 3: Radiation to the lung \> 30 Gy within 6 months prior to the first dose of study treatment

ehr_lines.text: PATIENT IDENTIFIER: PT-102 | NAME: Marcus Vance | DOB/AGE: 68yo Male | REF DATE: 2026-11-14
CLINICAL ENCOUNTER: Phase 3 / Phase 1/2 Trial Eligibility Review (Targets: NCT04613596 & NCT04787042)
Marcus Vance is a 68-year-old male (40 pack-year former smoker) evaluated for enrollment into NCT04613596 (KRYSTAL-7 Phase 3) and NCT04787042 (ST-067 Phase 1/2) for metastatic NSCLC.
Primary Diagnosis: Stage IV (cT2bN2M1c) squamous/non-squamous NSCLC (adenocarcinoma predominant), diagnosed 2026-08-18.
Target Disease Burden (RECIST 1.1): Measurable 4.1 cm left lower lobe (LLL) pulmonary mass with ipsilateral mediastinal lymphadenopathy and solitary right frontal brain metastasis.

2026-10-31 Brain MRI w/ contrast: 1.6 cm right frontal lobe parenchymal metastasis with surrounding moderate vasogenic peritumoral edema causing mild left-sided clumsiness and morning headache. No brainstem lesion.
- Neurosurgical/RT consultation pending for right frontal lesion; no cranial RT completed yet.
- Dexamethasone 2 mg PO BID (total daily dose = 4.0 mg/day), started 2026-11-01 and ONGOING as of 2026-11-14 for symptomatic peritumoral edema around the 1.6 cm right frontal brain lesion.
[Potency Calculation: 4.0 mg/day Dexamethasone * (5.0 / 0.75) = 26.7 mg/day Prednisone equivalent -> EXCEEDS 10.0 mg/day ceiling].

- Prior Systemic Anticancer Therapy: Completed 1 cycle of investigational anti-LAG-3 checkpoint modulator (relatlimab-class clinical study agent) in metastatic setting; last dose administered on 2026-10-26 (19 days prior to 2026-11-14; violates 28-day washout for NCT04787042 [earliest washout clearance: 2026-11-23] AND violates 0 prior metastatic systemic treatment lines for NCT04613596).
- Hepatic Function: AST 28 U/L (ULN 40) | ALT 31 U/L (ULN 40) | Total Bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL (ULN 1.2).
Assessor Note: CONTRAINDICATED for both NCT04613596 and NCT04787042 due to supratherapeutic steroid dose (26.7 mg/day Prednisone eq) and recent investigational systemic therapy (19 days ago).
